# Model card: Expected Fee

*Generated by `fairvalue train-fee` on 2026-11-13T07:31:31+00:00. All metrics are walk-forward by transfer season: each transfer is scored by a model trained only on earlier seasons.*

## What it estimates

The fee that transfers with comparable public information **at the transfer date** typically commanded. A transfer premium is fee − expected fee. A transfer is only labelled when its fee falls outside the 80% range (notable) or 95% range (unusual). Contract length, release clauses, add-ons, competition between clubs and agent terms are unobserved and sit inside the premium.

- **Target:** log(fee ÷ market value before the transfer). Expected fee = market value × exp(prediction).
- **Data:** 14,516 paid transfers 2015/16–2026 (to 6 Jul 2026) with a market value at most 365 days old.
- **Features (all point-in-time):** market value and 12-month trend; performance-implied relative value for the last finished season; age, position; buyer's fees paid and seller's fees received in the previous 365 days; buyer and seller league; window and deadline week; recent playing time; market premium level (median fee/value ratio of the previous 12 months).

## Accuracy

|                                                      |     n |   mae_log |   r2_log_fee | median_ape   | within_25pct   | within_50pct   |   bias_log |
|:-----------------------------------------------------|------:|----------:|-------------:|:-------------|:---------------|:---------------|-----------:|
| Baseline: fee = market value                         | 12520 |    0.7022 |       0.6636 | 50.0%        | 29.9%          | 51.6%          |    -0.1706 |
| Baseline: fee = market value x recent market premium | 12520 |    0.693  |       0.6757 | 47.7%        | 28.2%          | 52.4%          |    -0.0592 |
| Ridge (chosen)                                       | 12520 |    0.6293 |       0.74   | 44.4%        | 29.2%          | 55.4%          |    -0.0365 |
| Gradient boosting                                    | 12520 |    0.6019 |       0.7604 | 42.6%        | 30.1%          | 57.7%          |    -0.0433 |

*Errors are on fees in euros (market value cancels, so they equal errors on the premium). r2_log_fee is R² on log fee, where market value alone already explains most of the variance; the question is how much the model adds.* gbm MAE 0.6019 vs ridge 0.6293 (< 5% better); coverage80 gbm 0.8178 vs ridge 0.8153.

## Club Transfer Audit (2015/16–2026, clubs with ≥ 8 assessed purchases)

price_ratio = total fees ÷ total expected fees, with an 80% bootstrap range over the club's transfers (transfer-level model uncertainty isn't included, so the true uncertainty is wider). The outcome column is the median market-value change 12 months after signing: **an outcome, not used by any model**. Price efficiency isn't sporting success.
